tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Level-set normals and Hessians]

Source: petersen:page-0108, petersen:page-0109 ↗ def:pet-ch3-second-fundamental-form ↗ def:pet-ch3-hessian-square-notation

1. ch3:3.2.1Let $H\subset f^{-1}(a)$ be open and consist entirely of regular points of $f$. Then:

  1. $N= abla f/| abla f|$ is a unit normal to $H$;

  2. $\Pi (X,Y)=\dfrac 1{| abla f|}\operatorname {Hess}f(X,Y)$ for $X,Y\in TH$;

  3. $\operatorname {Hess}f( abla f,X)= frac 12D_X| abla f|^2$ for $X\in TM$.

Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch3-normal-hessian-relation

\sketch Tangency to a level set gives $g( abla f,X)=df(X)=0$, proving (1). Differentiating $N= abla f/| abla f|$ and pairing with tangent $Y$ removes the derivative of $| abla f|^{-1}$ and proves (2). Finally,

\[ \operatorname {Hess}f( abla f,X) =g( abla _X abla f, abla f) = frac 12X| abla f|^2, \]

which proves (3).

□
